method: Five fresh Node worker processes per scale/concurrency/seed. Cold metric includes JSON replay, candidate state and initial bounded archive query; filesystem cache is not flushed. Concurrent sessions share one event loop.
failedRunPartialQueries: UNKNOWN; missing worker metrics are not zero latency
baselineComparison: UNAVAILABLE: existing P0 uses a different fixture and measurement path; no no-regression claim
caseSource: Controlled synthetic logs; real candidate public retrieval tools; fixture windows constructed using repository WindowController and host heuristic token meter; no provider calls
limitations: Search measurements cover one bounded response page, not exhaustive cursor traversal.
Per-query scanBudgetReached/incomplete/nextCursor flags were not retained by this worker version.
Before/after memory and 100 query batches do not establish absence of a long-term leak.
All concurrent sessions in a cell replay the same synthetic source; this matrix alone does not establish absence of cross-session content contamination. Independent cursor/source tests are separate.
Worker timing percentiles are conditional on successful process completion; all OOM attempts remain in denominators.
